name: Full name of the person, e.g. 'Jenna Richards'. Use 'Unknown' if no name was given.
company_website: Company website domain, e.g. sadowskico.com. Empty string if not given.
role: Their job title. 'Unknown' if not given.
email: Their email address. Empty string if not given. Never invent one.
email_source: Where the email came from, e.g. 'hunter (found)', 'hunter (inferred)', 'website'. Empty string if not given.
notes: Why this is a qualified lead, plus any other useful context from the input
